failure_conditions: Any mandatory critical gate is FAIL or BLOCKED at release decision time.
Frozen traceability corpus SHA-256 differs from f80475f84faad0afeb57da0d4db385274debe0760f87e2687fec0457d7ba3c21.
Any frozen invalid graph misses a preregistered expected diagnostic code.
Any frozen valid or impact graph emits an error diagnostic.
Any critical requirement in an accepted graph lacks a complete ordered traceability path.
Any frozen impact set differs from preregistration.
Diagnostic code precision on frozen invalid cases is below 1.0.
Any applicable inherited regression fails or disappears without approved retirement.
The v0.05 approved specification emits an unsuppressed v0.04 linter finding.
The evaluator actor is also the implementation actor.
Missing evaluation cases or denominator data are treated as zero or complete evidence.

goals.acceptance: Every accepted critical requirement has a complete goal→requirement→feature→task→test→gate path and every frozen incomplete case is rejected.
goals.description: Make critical delivery traceability mechanically verifiable.

goals.acceptance: All 20 frozen invalid graph cases contain every preregistered expected diagnostic code and no accepted graph emits an error.
goals.description: Reject structurally invalid or semantically invalid traceability graphs deterministically.

goals.acceptance: All 5 frozen impact cases exactly match preregistered upstream and downstream node sets.
The inherited automated suite and active REG-0001 through REG-0006 all pass, and the v0.05 spec remains lint-clean.
goals.description: Preserve all v0.04 controls while adding the traceability layer.

hash_scope: Canonical UTF-8 JSON with sorted keys and compact separators, excluding the contract_hash property.
promotion_conditions: All mandatory gates PASS and all frozen primary and guardrail metrics meet target.
All metrics reconcile to raw evaluation evidence and denominator snapshots.
All applicable regressions REG-0001 through REG-0006 PASS and new meaningful defects are considered for regression memory.
Frozen corpus and evaluation-plan hashes remain intact.
Independent evaluator recommendation is recorded and evaluator differs from implementation actor.
No critical open defect remains and release manifest/rollback declaration are complete.
Because evaluation is synthetic, the maximum release classification is PROMOTED AS EXPERIMENTAL unless independent real-project evidence is added under a separately preregistered contract.

requirements.description: Parse a versioned JSON traceability graph with typed nodes and edges.
Reject duplicate node IDs and duplicate directed edges.
Reject edges whose source or target node does not exist.
Enforce allowed edge type transitions for primary and preregistered auxiliary relations.
Detect directed cycles in the delivery graph.
Compute complete critical traceability from goal through requirement, feature, task, test, and gate.
Detect orphan critical requirements and the first missing required traceability stage.
Compute upstream and downstream impact sets for changed node IDs.
Expose traceability validation and impact analysis through importable API and deterministic CLI JSON output.
Preserve v0.04 validator, linter, historical-release, and append-only regression behavior.

rollback_expectations.expectation: If v0.05 fails, v0.04 remains the active promoted-experimental release; preserve all v0.05 experiment evidence and frozen artifacts without rewriting v0.04 history.
